objective: Write and commit the approved cross-repository design specification in an isolated rpg-project worktree. Repository: /home/kirk/game-dev/rpg-project. Create `docs/superpowers/specs/2026-08-12-dungeon-builder-encounter-v03-alignment-design.md`. This is design documentation only—do not implement code, alter sessions/active.md, role context, issues, or PRs. Use concise but complete architecture/data-flow/error/testing sections. Approved decisions: (1) target implemented rpg-toolkit PR #932 encounter v0.3 surface now, using a temporary rpg-api local module override until tagged; (2) preserve author-friendly room-chain Dungeon YAML, first fixture `rpg-api/internal/content/dungeons/reference-tomb.yaml`; (3) toolkit owns a compiler/provider adapter from room-chain YAML to v0.3 SetupInput plus stable provider projection—odd-q conversion, room origins, connectivity, topology, and validation never move into API/web; (4) rpg-api issue #793 wires v0.3, persists composition blob plus immutable compiled content sidecar atomically and identity/version binds them; (5) existing protos do not change; PutDungeon/FloorPlan and encounter v1alpha2 remain the wire surfaces; (6) web renders only server-returned FloorPlan/encounter facts, no Atlas/Absolute/Locate or coordinate/topology logic leaks to browser; (7) Save & Play enabled only for accepted room-chain YAML after v0.3 API adapter works; (8) existing region-union implementation/tests preserved but capability-gated/hard-stopped, not stripped or approximated, until v0.3 mask-room support; (9) static props/facing/walls/region names/entrance/provenance live in toolkit-produced compiled content sidecar; actors compile to SetupInput members; (10) reference tomb acceptance must prove validate preview, exact stable proto projection, Save & Play, kissing doorways, continuous movement across rooms, persistence/reload, and no web derivation; (11) current API PR #782 and web PR #748 are draft/holding inputs to revise rather than merge as-is. Explicitly document what PR #932 does and does not provide: rectangular anchored rooms, absolute Atlas cells/occluders/boundaries/doorways, Absolute/Locate, W1-W5 and persistence; no Dungeon YAML compiler, freeform masks, static presentation sidecar, or API wiring. Correct prior misunderstanding: occluders are not structural holes. Do not prescribe API-owned topology. Include phased implementation order across toolkit adapter, API, then web, but no detailed implementation plan yet. Include failure modes/error states and non-goals (region masks, doors/locks, fine rotation, lighting, proto changes). Self-review for placeholders, contradictions, ambiguity, and scope; fix inline. Commit only the new spec with a conventional docs commit. Return commit SHA, path, summary, and self-review result.
